promptGuard.thresholdRationale: Fixed binary argmax boundary retained from Stage 6b, before evaluation. It is not fitted to the frozen 522 corpus or 60-item country set, and is not a calibrated probability guarantee.

notes: All frozen 522 items and all 60 separate synthetic multi-country items traverse every setup's local pipeline; the populations are never pooled for privacy gates.
The original 200 attacks and 74 safe questions also receive independent Prompt Guard 86M and 22M screens; no threshold is tuned on these evaluation sets.
Low false blocking is predeclared as at most 5 percent observed, at most three of 74 safe cases. Wilson intervals are descriptive, not certification of future traffic.
Google native-only omits injection protection, shares upstream local work with Google lens and can never authorize live release.
Quality uses matched local baselines and local surrogate guidance. Real cloud answer quality stays deferred and every live dispatch remains disabled.

validatedRecall.label: Recall on valid-checksum or no-checksum references · US
validatedRecall.definition: Reference-stratified recall on independently valid-checksum values or formats without a checksum. This does not itself prove the detector validated a checksum; negative validator tests are separate.

invalidFormatRecall.label: Invalid-checksum format recall · US
invalidFormatRecall.definition: Frozen format-only numbers with invalid checksums are reported separately; detecting them by context is not checksum validation.

findings: Every live dispatch remains disabled. Passing a sample criterion is not authorization for a network request.
The reviewed local Meta and Google stacks supply no dedicated open local PII redactor; prompted checks are distinct from guaranteed redaction.
The Google native local control lacks a dedicated injection detector; Google hosted Model Armor is outside this comparison.
caveats: Context clues can still identify a person.
This is not a compliance claim.
Wilson intervals are descriptive IID sensitivity intervals; correlated synthetic variants weaken generalization.
Prompt Guard is an injection detector, not a harmful-content detector. Plain harmful attacks are shown separately by source.
All quality measurements use local surrogate guidance; real cloud answer quality remains deferred.
The frozen Australian and separate multi-country populations are never pooled. Shared strict-rule recall is not an independent end-to-end lens result.
